question: Is a spell cast using jump-start always exiled afterward, even if it is countered?

expected.shortAnswer: Yes: it is always exiled afterward, whether it resolves, is countered or leaves the stack in another way.
expected.answer: A spell cast using jump-start will always be exiled afterward, whether it resolves, it's countered, or it leaves the stack in some other way.
